rccl._comment_platform: MI350X single-node 8-GPU scale-up (xGMI) all_reduce check against the AMD validation guide bar. Run with rccl_perf on one node; rccl_regression and rccl_pairwise are not intended for this config.

mpi_params._comment_mpi_pml: Single-node collectives run over xGMI and MPI only bootstraps ranks, so ob1 avoids UCX backend-NIC auto-detection.
mpi_params._comment_mpi_dir: Open MPI install prefix. A trailing /bin is stripped.
mpi_params._comment_mpi_oob_port: TCP interface used for MPI bootstrap, e.g. the management interface.

rccl._comment_env_script: RCCL/HSA tuning script for this platform, or "none" to run with rccl-tests defaults.

cvs_params._comment_fabric: scale_up reads only results.scale_up.<collective>-<data_types>-<ranks>; NIC-keyed and flat references are ignored, and a missing key fails when verify_bus_bw is True.
cvs_params._comment_bus_bw_tolerance: 1.0 enforces the published bar exactly; the 0.95 default would accept 5% below it.

rccl._comments_results: AMD validation guide bar for MI350X: single-node 8-GPU all_reduce bus BW >= 350 GB/s at 8 GiB (8589934592 bytes), in-place, float. Do not use this as an MI355X gate; the MI355X bar is unresolved (see the RCCL README).
